body_text:
E-Bike Tours

 See Door County Like Never Before
This pedal-assisted e-Bike tour of Door County gives you a one-of-kind view of the Peninsula. The tour travels to some must-see spots in Door County, plus so much more! This eBike tour offers a fun commentary via a guide, so you can learn everything about the city on your ride. You have a private guide showing you around, so you never have to look at a map or get lost.

Your tour guide even takes photos of you and your group along your excursion. One of the great advantages of this tour is you don’t have to waste any time figuring out where to go. This is the only way to see all of Door County in a fun and active way while riding a cool eBike.

Important Info

Young adults ages 14-18 are welcome to ride their own bike accompanied by an adult

All tours have a minimum of 2 bikes

You should know how to operate a bike.

Tour route is subject to change because of possible road closures due to summer street fairs, parades, construction.

Helmets are required

Discover the natural beauty of Door County with an e-bike rental! Hop on one of our comfortable, eco-friendly e-bikes and cruise through scenic routes to Cave Point County Park and Whitefish Bay Dunes State Park. Whether you’re looking to enjoy the peaceful trails or take in the stunning views of Lake Michigan, our e-bikes make exploring these beautiful destinations effortless and fun.
